notes.title: Alien Attack v1.4 update
notes.content:
Unexpected update is here!

Added:
[list]
[*] [b]New palettes selection system:[/b] now you can buy palettes which you want the most, using points. The palette shop is in the main menu, below the "START" button.
[*] [b]New skin[/b] [i]([spoiler]unlocked after getting "Palette Lover!" achievement[/spoiler])[/i].
[*] [b]Updated achievements' images:[/b] the game's visual style has changed since 2016, so there are new images.
[*] [b]Smooth menus' navigations:[/b] it looks a lot cooler when they're smooth... right?
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

Have fun!

And don't forget to post bugs [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/391310/discussions/]here[/url] if you find some.

notes.title: Alien Attack: In Space v1.0 now avaliable!
notes.content:
— Multi-language support, added:
[list]
[*] Traditional+Simplified Chinese language
[*] Italian language
[*] German language
[*] French language
[*] Japanese language
[*] Portguese language
[*] Spanish language
[/list]
If there are some issues with translation, go to Discussions' tread and write there about it: it will be fixed ASAP.
— Bigger screen update: no more claustrophobia.
— Improved shooting and alien spawning mechanics
— DSG changed to Alien Jellyfish everywhere
— Added a bunch of palettes (15)
— Optimized code
— Transferred to a new engine (from GM:S to GM:S2)
— ... And some minor fixes
